key_insight: Musec stabilizes Muon training by clipping overly large momentum singular values instead of flattening all of them to one, preserving spectral structure while preventing instability.
engineering_relevance: This provides an architecture-agnostic optimizer-level fix for large-scale model training, reducing loss spikes and weight blow-up without requiring model-specific clipping tricks.
method: Replace Muon’s spectral flattening with threshold-based spectral clipping.
Use Soft Musec for smooth spectral saturation via coupled Newton-Schulz iterations.
Provide convergence guarantees for nonconvex nonsmooth stochastic optimization.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports empirical evaluation across a wide range of learning rates and model sizes, where Soft Musec stays stable even when existing Muon variants diverge and matches their performance when well tuned.
watch_item: Soft Musec adds iterative spectral approximation overhead, so practical efficiency and numerical stability depend on the quality of the Newton-Schulz implementation and chosen threshold.
paper_title: Musec: MomentUm SpEctral Clipping for Stable Muon-type Training
